snippet.title: Rogue Shell - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4459650

Rogue Shell is an atmospheric action roguelike set far into a dark future, where you play as a small robotic shell trying to escape the deepest layers of a decaying megastructure. Explore, scavenge, upgrade your gear, fight to survive - and to understand.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/f2h5SG3jkh
Support the development: https://www.patreon.com/cw/RogueShell

Music by Dark Fantasy Studio

#roguelite #roguelike #indiegame #trailer
